requested_outcome: Restore every current catalog and unit image, prevent pre-hydration failures from leaving broken frames, diagnose the observed global error screen, verify the affected family and publish only a fully observed candidate.
natural_destination: Public VII place pages, unit cards, unit detail dialogs, booking dialogs and galleries on desktop and mobile.
authorization_boundary: Code, generated media inventory, bounded R2 migration and production publication are authorized by the active request. Do not change catalog business data, schema, secrets, environment, DNS, domains, permissions or billing.
no_applicable_lessons_reason: The mandatory project master plan and feedback standard paths are absent. Current production evidence and the user's screenshots are authoritative for this incident.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The exact screenshot is hidden by a fallback but the real unit images remain unavailable.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reconcile every live catalog media reference with the immutable inventory and R2, then verify HTTP content type and browser decoding.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The exact eight vacation-164 unit cards show their real images and all live catalog media references return decodable image responses.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Images that fail before hydration still leave alt text and an empty frame.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a shared resilient image component that checks the decoded state after hydration in addition to onError.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Forced pre-hydration failures switch to an honest property fallback or neutral unavailable state in every unit surface.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the visible card is fixed while dialogs, booking cards or other places still break.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Apply and test the shared boundary across place cards, unit details and booking dialogs, then audit the full live catalog.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and mobile family tests find zero broken unit images and zero global error screens.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A local build is reported as fixed while production still serves 404 media or the error page.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Require exact deployment identity and repeat browser and HTTP audits against the public candidate.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public exact-page and full-family audits pass after the final deployment with rollback recorded.

midpoint_gate.trigger: The exact page renders locally with the refreshed inventory and forced failures.
checks: real vacation-164 unit media is allowlisted
pre-hydration failure has no broken frame
dialogs share the same resilience boundary

attack_questions: Can a live catalog image be absent from the manifest?
Can a request fail before hydration?
Can both unit and property images fail?
Can lazy loading hide failures below the fold?
Can any place navigation reach the global error screen?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: The exact public place and all eight unit cards on desktop and mobile.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Full live media reconciliation, targeted contracts, production build, forced failure tests and public browser audit.

effectiveness.baseline: v768 passed only primary-image checks and missed 1,083 live unit/detail media objects plus failures that occurred before hydration.
effectiveness.target: Zero live catalog media gaps, zero broken decoded images and zero observed global error screens.
